value.rationale: Two-wall force noise is a direct physical observable beyond a mean ideal-gas pressure law. The explicit finite-width cross-covariance is strictly negative for all parameters, its correlation has a sharp strict range, net-force fluctuations remain box-size-independent, and a noncommutation of stationary wide-box and long-observation limits is rigorously established. These structural boundary effects are physically motivated rather than arbitrary numerical slices.
